name: mobile-release
description: Get iOS and Android releases through App Store and Google Play review and roll them out safely. Three deterministic stdlib scripts: an iOS check that matches required-reason API use in source against PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy (valid and SDK-only reason codes per category), purpose strings in Info.plist or INFOPLIST_KEY_ settings and vendored SDK manifests; an Android check for Play's dated target API level by form factor, android:exported, debuggable builds, permissions that need a Play Console declaration and 16 KB page alignment read from ELF headers; and a rollout gate that returns PROCEED, HOLD or HALT from crash and ANR counts against the previous release and Play's bad-behavior thresholds. Ships cs-mobile-release agent, /cs-mobile-release and /cs-rollout-gate commands and 3 cited references.
